purpose: Keep the complete LLM-wiki product visible and implemented as a private, source-anchored, review-gated local memory product without silently enabling a live vector store, RAG, or GraphRAG backend.

phases.meaning: Private source-anchored semantic entries with schema, index, stale detection and Forge boundary.
A maintained private wiki product with entry model, ingestion queue, review states, staleness management, human/AI indexes, and source-backed receipts.
A manual and future-scheduler-compatible worker that proposes memory candidates with source anchors, duplicate detection, privacy scans and receipts; it never mutates source truth without review.
A controlled adapter boundary exists, but real FTS/RAG/GraphRAG/vector backends remain disabled until a separate Prism-reviewed activation task opens them.

promotion_triggers: explicit RedCap task approved for live RAG/GraphRAG backend activation
repeated retrieval-miss observations show metadata/index route is insufficient
must_not_claim: Full LLM-wiki controlled-local product is still not a source of truth.
The background worker is proposal-only and does not rewrite source truth.
No live vector store, RAG, or GraphRAG backend is enabled.
Wiki summaries never replace source policies, task ledgers, receipts, or raw evidence.
